title: After The Sunset
overview: At 73, Arvind Joshi thought his life was meant to be lived in solitude-until an unexpected friendship reawakened his heart. Through art, conversation, and an unspoken bond, he discovers that love, warmth, and new beginnings don't come with an expiry date. After the Sunset is a poignant tale of loneliness, love, and second chances-reminding us that it's never too late to embrace life again.
